tie_breakers: Density E~N (14 edges / 13 nodes): chain-like, not mesh or fabric-like; there is no anti-parallel pair and no redundant lane the source calls redundant.
No bus with disconnected worlds: every node reaches box through the uplink, so placement-planes does not apply.
Identifier/qualifier content outranks shape: the graph is a deep address-labelled chain -> identity-probe-maps.
Motion is not a signature here: the source describes a topology statically, so the diagram is static and carries no dots.

relationship_mapping.note: every source relation has exactly one visible view relationship; no relation crosses a view boundary untraceably
relationship_mapping.join_note: bond0, box, wlp and ts are drawn in more than one view on purpose: each view shows the relations that start or end at them, so the join keeps the chain traceable across views without duplicating a relation (box shows NAT/docker/overlay ingress in v1 and its two physical ports in v2; bond0 and wlp show the ports in v1/v2 and their gateway links in v3)
relationship_mapping.direction_check: no relation was reversed; the source states each direction as producer -> consumer and every drawn edge keeps it (vm -> virbr -> box; ctr -> dkbr -> box; ts -> box and ts -> bond0; box -> bond0 and box -> wlp; bond0/wlp -> rtr; rtr -> ont -> vzagg -> vzbb -> cf)
